text:
`ext/Mention` now has `doc/architecture.md` (71 lines), linked from its readme's `## More` line, committed as `9b9aa631c`.

- **File:** `public/framework/ext/Mention/doc/architecture.md`, 71 lines, 10 decisions, each checked against `Mention.js`, `View.js` and `Server/plugins/MentionSync.js`.
- **Code mismatches:** no `⚠` code mismatches. One CSS-order `⚠` is kept as a warning, since it holds today but is easy to break. The census decision names `registry.js`, which is stale; the doc uses the real `maps/refs.js` and `maps/people.js`.
- **Extras:** `doc/files.jsonl` already held one entry for each file, so there was nothing to dedupe. I left `page.js` alone as you asked, so its `notes:` does not list `architecture`. I also did not add an `architecture` entry there.

Outside my fence: `core/Page/PageContent.js` (line 107) and `Mention-notes.md` point to `doc/decisions.md`, which doesn't exist in `ext/Mention`. The census decision also links to `/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/03/list-events/mention-auto-sync/`, which I did not open.

✅ `ui/panel/doc/architecture.md`, 39 lines, committed as `799bd65c9` in the worktree with the readme's `## More` link.
⚠️ No code mismatches. The one ⚠ in the doc is a trade-off, not a stale claim: `reverse` also reverses DOM order.
Left alone: `page.js` (no `notes:` list, per your instruction), and there was no `doc/files.jsonl` to dedupe.

- **File:** `public/framework/ext/System/doc/architecture.md`, 46 lines. It has four decisions and two mismatches. Committed in `1cd3f363e` and `13450da2c`.
- **Also:** the readme gained a `## More` line linking it. `doc/files.jsonl` now declares it, and has no duplicate entries. `page.js` is untouched and has no `notes:` list, so there was nothing to add there.
- **⚠ code mismatches:**
  - `heal_limit` (default 3) is declared in `System.js`, but nothing reads it, so no cap is enforced.
  - The census decision that says `page.js` documents the class is accurate. `SystemPage` extends `Page`, but that is the page, not `System`.

`ui/table` now has a `doc/architecture.md` (25 lines), committed in the worktree as `3206efcad` and `ebb836171`.

- **File:** `public/framework/ui/table/doc/architecture.md`. Three entries, all checked against `ext/DataGrid/DataGrid.js`. The readme's `## More` line links to it. `page.js` is untouched, so its `notes:` does not list `architecture` (you asked to leave it alone).
- **Line count:** 25.
- **⚠ code mismatches:** none. The census had no decisions for `ui/table`, so the entries come from the code and the DataGrid architecture doc.

Dedupe: `files.jsonl` had no duplicate entries. The page system added a `doc/` line to it and created `doc/files.jsonl`, and I committed both.

Toolbar architecture doc is committed as `a2d7a3cb0`.

- `public/framework/ui/toolbar/doc/architecture.md`, 49 lines, six decisions, each checked against `page.js`.
- No `⚠` mismatches. The readme gained a `## More` line linking it. `page.js` is untouched, since it has no `notes:` list.

Two things differ from the brief: the decisions census returned nothing, so I took the decisions from the page's own notes; and there is no `doc/files.jsonl` to dedupe, since the only `files.jsonl` is at the module root and has no duplicates.

Done. `ui/timeline` now has `doc/architecture.md`, committed as `176cf70e6` in the worktree.

- **File:** `public/framework/ui/timeline/doc/architecture.md`, 42 lines. Covers four decisions: a plain function rather than a class, rows as `[when, what, note]` triples, the line as a border on an empty box, and the run stopping by `:last-child` CSS rather than an index. The colour decision is in there too.
- **Also committed:** a link under `## More` in `readme.md`, and `doc/files.jsonl` declaring `architecture.md` so the Docs tab shows it. The `files.jsonl` write hit the jsonl guard, but the file on disk is a single valid line and is what got committed.
- **Code mismatches:** none. Every entry matches `timeline.js` and `page.js` as they are now.

Not done: `page.js` has no `notes:` list, so I left it alone as you asked. `timeline/files.jsonl` shows as modified in the worktree; I didn't touch it and didn't commit it.

Section's `doc/architecture.md` is committed (`ba67d6611`) in the worktree.

- **File:** `public/framework/core/Section/doc/architecture.md`, 78 lines, plus the readme `More` line and `doc/files.jsonl` entry.
- **⚠ mismatches:** none. Every decision I checked matches the code.
- **Not done:** the Docs page's `notes:` list in `doc/page.js` does not name `architecture`, because you said to leave page.js alone. The file is listed in `doc/files.jsonl`, but it won't appear as a note on that page until someone adds it.
- **Dedupe:** `doc/files.jsonl` had no duplicate entries, so nothing was removed.

Wrote `public/framework/ui/accordion/doc/architecture.md`, 45 lines, five decisions, committed in the worktree (`bb3429bb2`, `d64072fb3`).

- **⚠ code mismatches:** none. The code matches all five entries.
- **Skipped:** `page.js` has no `notes:` list, so I left it alone. The census returned no decisions for `ui/accordion`.
- **Extras:** `doc/files.jsonl` had one line, so there was nothing to dedupe. The root `files.jsonl` gained a `doc/` line from the harness; I committed it with the new doc folder.

Done: `ext/catalog/doc/architecture.md` (78 lines), committed as `d2136d91c`.

- **File:** `public/framework/ext/catalog/doc/architecture.md`, 78 lines, plus the `More` bullet in `readme.md` and the `doc/files.jsonl` dedupe (9 lines down to 7). I skipped the `page.js` `notes:` entry because you said to leave `page.js` alone.
- **Code mismatches:** one `⚠`, the known open item. `/framework/ai/<day>/` still clips below `64em` while routed, and the fix belongs in `ai.css`. I found no other stale claims in the entries I checked against the code.
- **Note:** the decision census returned only one off-topic entry, so the entries come from `doc/decisions.md`, checked against the source.

1. `public/framework/ui/badge/doc/architecture.md`, 35 lines, committed as e97c9ece8 with the readme's `More` link.
2. Lines: 35 lines, under the 80-line limit.
3. Code mismatches: none. The census returned no `decision` lines for ui/badge, so the four entries come from `badge.js` and `page.js`. `ui-pill` and `h4` are defined outside this module and I did not check them.

Skipped per your extras: `page.js` is untouched, so the `architecture` entry is not in its `notes:` list. `files.jsonl` had no duplicates to remove.

Committed `0aacf2cae` in the worktree.

- **File:** `public/framework/ext/toc/doc/architecture.md`, 71 lines. Readme `More` line added and `doc/files.jsonl` deduped to 5 unique lines. `page.js` left alone, so it has no `architecture` note.
- **⚠ code mismatches:**
  - `toc.css` is not ASCII-only: its comments contain `⚠` and other non-ASCII bytes, against the ASCII rule in `decisions.md`. Flagged in the doc, not fixed (outside fence).
  - `decisions.md`'s "overview: no-ops" trap cites a `.pages >` selector that the code no longer has. Flagged as unverified in a browser.

ui/avatar now has `doc/architecture.md`, linked from its readme, and both commits are in the worktree.

- **File:** `public/framework/ui/avatar/doc/architecture.md`, 49 lines. Five decisions, each checked against `avatar.js`.
- **⚠ mismatch:** the page's note says `.wash` "inherits the rest", but it also sets its letters to `--ink`. The code is right; the wording is in `page.js`, which was outside my fence, so I left it.

Two things differ from the brief:
- No `ArchitectureCensus` decisions came back for `ui/avatar`, and it has no `doc/decisions.md`. The one avatar decision in the logs is about the chat role avatar, so I did not use it.
- The `doc/files.jsonl` dedupe had nothing to do: the only entry was a single line. Committing the new `doc/` folder also changed the generated `files.jsonl` at the module root, so I committed that index too.
